topic: The observation that did not fit the graph
grammarFocus: 学术论证的限定、因果、对比与证据范围
title: The observation that did not fit the graph
instructions: 原创学术微训练；场景、机构与数值均为虚构模拟，不是事实报道或官方试题。先独立阅读答题，再用原句核对限定、比较与因果。短篇专项不能替代完整陌生测评。
passage:
A. In a fictional materials laboratory, a student tested how quickly paper strips absorbed coloured water. Most strips produced similar results, but one absorbed water much more slowly. Removing it made the graph look orderly. Her supervisor asked her to preserve the observation until there was a documented reason to exclude it. An inconvenient value was not automatically an invalid one.

B. The laboratory notebook showed that the slow strip came from the edge of a sheet. The student had also used a different pair of scissors for that strip. Either difference might matter, but neither had been tested. Describing one as the cause would have turned a possible explanation into a conclusion. The original experiment had not been designed to separate these factors.

C. To investigate, the student cut new strips from both the edge and the centre, using each pair of scissors in turn. She assigned the strips coded labels so that the assistant timing absorption did not know their origin. The procedure reduced one source of expectation bias. It did not eliminate every possible difference in handling, so the report described what had and had not been controlled.

D. In the repeat experiment, edge strips tended to absorb more slowly regardless of the scissors used. The result supported further investigation of the paper edge. It did not establish which physical property caused the difference, and the sample came from only one sheet. The student therefore restricted her conclusion to the tested material rather than making a claim about all manufactured paper.

E. Her final graph showed every original result, followed by the repeat experiment in a separate panel. A note explained why the second test had been designed. Readers could see how an anomaly led to a more focused question. The supervisor argued that a transparent chain of observations and decisions was more valuable than a visually perfect first graph. The unresolved mechanism became a future research question rather than an embarrassment to hide.

Changing every value to the mean.
Using uncoloured water for all strips.

grammar.title: 区分让步与原因
grammar.explanation: although 表示“虽然”，because 表示“因为”；按两句的实际关系选词，不按相邻位置猜。
grammar.example: Her supervisor asked her to preserve the observation until there was a documented reason to exclude it.

questions.prompt: _____ the trial was small, its records were complete. （明确要表达让步关系；只填空白，保持其余文字不变）
questions.explanation: although 表示“虽然”，because 表示“因为”；按两句的实际关系选词，不按相邻位置猜。 本句为：Although the trial was small, its records were complete.
questions.evidence: Although the trial was small, its records were complete.
